# Clober

> A fully on-chain central-limit-order-book (CLOB) perpetuals DEX on Solana whose
> accounting is machine-proven: every money-moving instruction is Kani/Lean-verified
> to preserve solvency, and the oracle-manipulation attack class that cost a
> competitor $20M+ is proven impossible by construction. Devnet, unaudited.

Program ID: 8Vdd5n4zbmxqwqY8Xv8JbEcvbih3JsEZzJBtfkoeGp2z (Solana). Anchor program.
Amounts are integers: quote_lots, ticks (price = ticks × tick_size), base_lots.
side 0=long 1=short. sub_index selects a sub-account (0=primary).

## Start here

- [Agent trading guide](AGENTS.md): the trading lifecycle, instruction signatures, state model, and a minimal client bootstrap.
- [Production invariants](INVARIANTS.md): the release contract for settlement, custody, risk, oracle, and authority safety.
- [Anchor IDL](idl/clober.json): the machine source of truth — 162 instructions, 31 accounts, 146 events, 120 typed errors.

## Core instructions

- open_trader_state(): create the per-wallet collateral/positions PDA.
- deposit_collateral(amount_quote_lots): fund the account (SPL transfer in).
- place_limit_order(side, size_lots, limit_ticks, flags, expires_at_slot, sub_index): rest an order on the hypertree book (the sole limit path).
- place_taker_order(...): cross the book; emits FillBatchEvent.
- crank_funding(): permissionless; advance cum_funding_index (rate-capped, oracle-gated, Δt clamped).
- settle_funding(): realize a position's funding into collateral via the proven route_funding path.
- partial_withdraw_collateral(amount_quote_lots): withdraw anytime, gated by withdrawable = collateral − max(IM, floor) − er_reserved.

## Safety guarantees (machine-proven, CI-gated)

- [Formal verification overview](docs/FORMAL_VERIFICATION.md): the full proof list.
- Solvency conservation V = C_tot + I + Residual preserved by every money move (Lean; formal_verification/lean/).
- No self-liquidation onto insurance (Kani withdraw_cannot_self_liquidate_below_maintenance).
- Manipulated/thin-market paper PnL cannot back margin or be withdrawn (Lean; formal_verification/lean/).
- Margin requirement is collateral-frame-stable on the real assess_margin (Kani).
